m: शाबीय See शापीय.

शाबल्या (आ), f. (prob.) a female buffoon, VS. (TS. शाबुल्या).
शाबल्य n. a mixture, medley, BhP.
शाबरायण m. patr. fr. शबर, g. हरितादि.
शाबरी (ई), f. the dialect of the Śabaras, Sāh.; Mṛcch., Introd.
Carpopogon Pruriens, L.

Symplocos Racemosa, Bhpr. (cf. सावर)

darkness, L.

a: शाब(व)र — a. (री f.) [शब(व) र-अण्] 1 Savage, barbarous. --2 Low, vile, base. --रः 1 An offence, a fault. --2 Sin, wickedness. --3 The tree called Lodhra. --री A low form of the Prākṛta dialect (spoken by mountaineers &c.) --Comp. --भेदाख्यं (also भेदाक्षं) copper.

m: शाबर—भाष्य n. N. of Śabara's commentary on the Mīmāṃsā-sūtras.
शाबर—भेदाख्य n. copper, L.
शाबर—चिन्तामणि m. N. of wk.
शाबरजम्बुक mfn. (fr. शबर-जम्बु), Pāṇ. iv, 2, 119, Sch.
शाबर—कौस्तुभ m. or n. N. of wk.
शाबरक m. (w.r. शाव्˚) Symplocos Racemosa, L.
शाबर—महा-तन्त्र n. N. of a Tantra by Śrī-kaṇṭha-śiva Paṇḍita.
शाबर—तन्त्र n. N. of wk.
शाबर—तन्त्र-सर्वस्व n. N. of wk.
शाबरि m. N. of a man, Buddh.
शाबरिका (इका), f. a kind of leech, Suśr.
शाबरोपनिषद् f. N. of an Upaniṣad.

शाबस्ती f. N. of a city, ib.
शाबस्त m. N. of a son of Yuvanāśva (and founder of the city Śābastī), BhP.
शाबस्ति m. patr. fr. शाबस्त, BhP.
शाब्दी (ई), f. Sarasvatī (as goddess of speech and eloquence), W.

s: tri, (SabdasyAyamiti । Sabda + aR .) SabdasambanDI । yaTA । ekaH SAbdo'paraScArTaH । iti dAyaBAgaH ॥ (SabdamayaH । yaTA, BAgavate । 2 । 2 । 2 । “SAbdasya hi brahmaRa eza panTA yannAmaBirDyAyati DIra pArTEH ॥”) sarasvatyAM strI, SAbdI । iti kecit ॥
m: शाब्द mf(ई)n. (fr. शब्द) sonorous, sounding, W.
relating to sound (as opp. to आर्थ, q.v.), Sāh.
based on sounds, expressed in words oral, verbal, (esp.) resting on or enjoined by sacred sound (i.e. on the Veda; with ब्रह्मन्. n. = ‘the Veda’), ŚBr. &c.
nominal (as inflection), W.
शाब्द m. a philologist, grammarian, RPrāt.
शाब्द m. pl. a partic. sect, Hcar.
a: शाब्द — a. (ब्दी f.) [शब्द-अण्] 1 Relating to or derived from a word. --2 Relating to or depending on sound (opp. आर्थ.). --3 Verbal, oral. --4 Sounding, sonorous. --5 Nominal (as inflection). --ब्दः A grammarian. --ब्दी N. of Sarasvatī. --Comp. --बोधः perception or apprehension of the sense of words. --व्यंजना insinuation founded on words.

s: puM, (SAbdaH SabdasambanDI boDaH .) SabdArTajYAnam । nyAyamate padArTajYAnajanyajYAnam । tasya karaRaM padajYAnam । tasya kAraRaM padaSaktijYAnam । kadAcit lakzaRAjYAnam । evaM AkANkzAyogyatAsattitAtparyyajYAnaYca । yaTA, -- “padajYAnantu karaRaM dvAraM tatra padArTaDIH । SAbdaboDaH PalaM tatra SaktiDIH sahakAriRI ॥” iti BAzAparicCedaH ॥ * ॥ SAbdaboDaprakAraM darSayati padajYAnantviti । na tu jYAyamAnaM padaM karaRaM padABAve'pi mOniSlokAdO SAbdaboDAt । padArTaDIriti padajanyapadArTasmaraRaM vyApAraH । anyaTA padajYAnavataH pratyakzAdinA padArTopasTitAvapi SAbdaboDApatteH । tatrApi vfttyA padajanyatvaM boDyaM anyaTA GawAdipadAt samavAyasambanDena AkASasmaraRe jAte AkASasyApi SAbdaboDApatteH । vfttiH SaktilakzaRAnyatarasambanDaH । atrEva SaktijYAnasya upayogaH । pUrvvaM SaktigrahABAve padajYAne'pi tatsambanDena smaraRAnupapatteH । padajYAnasya hi sambanDijYAnaviDeyArTasmArakatvam । * । SaktiSca padena saha padArTasya sambanDaH । asmAcCabdAdayamarTo bodDavya itISvarecCArUpA ADunike nAmni Saktirastyeva ekAdaSe'hani pitA nAma kuryyAditISvarecCAyAH sattvAt ADunike tu saNkete na Saktiriti sampradAyaH । navyAstu ISvarecCA na SaktiH kintvicCEva tenADunikasaNkete'pi SaktirastIti vadanti । * । SaktigrahaSca vyAkaraRAditaH । taTA hi । “SaktigrahaM vyAkaraRopamAnakozAptavAkyAdbyavahArataSca । vAkyasya SezAdbivftervvadanti sAnniDyataH sidDapadasya vfdDAH ॥” DAtuprakftipratyayAdInAM Saktigraho vyAkaraRAdBavati kvacittu sati bADake tyajyate'pi । yaTA, vEyAkaraRErAKyAtasya karttari Saktirucyate । cEtraH pacatItyAdO kartrA saha cEtrasyABedAnvayastatra gOravAnna janyate kintu kftO Saktigraho lAGavAt । kftiScEtrAdO prakArIBUya BAsate । na ca kartturanaBiDAnAccEtrAdipadAnantaraM tftIyA syAditi vAcyaM karttfsaMKyAnaBiDAnasya tatra tantratvAt । saMKyABiDAnayogyaSca karmmatvAdyanavarudDaH । praTamAntapadopasTApyakarmmatvAdItyasya viSezaRatvatAtparyyAvizayatvamarTaH tena cEtra iva gacCatItyAdO na cEtre saMKyAnvayaH । yatra karmmAdO na viSezaRatvatAtparyyaM tadvAraRAya praTamAnteti । yadvA DAtvarTAtiriktAviSezaRatvaM praTamadalArTaH tena cEtra iva gacCatItyatra cEtrAdervvAraRaM stokaM pacatItyAdO stokAdervvAraRAya ca dvitIyadalam । tasya dvitIyAntopasTApyatvAdbAraRam । evaM vyApAre'pi na SaktirgOravAt । raTo gacCati ityAdO tu svavyApAre ASrayatve vA lakzaRA । jAnAti ityAdO tu ASrayatve naSyatItyAdO pratiyogitve nirUQalakzaRA । upamAnAdyaTA SaktigrahastaToktam ॥ * ॥ evaM kozAdapi SaktigrahaH sati bADake kvacittyajyate yaTA nIlAdipadAnAM nIlarUpAdO nIlAdiviSizwe ca SaktiH koze vyutpAditA taTApi lAGavAt nIlAdO SaktiH nIlAdiviSizwe lakzaReti ॥ * ॥ evamAptavAkyAdapi । yaTA, kokilaH pikapadavAcyaH ityAdiSabdAt pikAdiSaktigrahaH ॥ * ॥ evaM vyavahArAdapi । yaTA, prayojakavfdDena GawamAnayetyuktaM tat SrutvA prayojyavfdDena Gawa AnItastadavaDAryya pArSvasTo bAlo GawAnayanarUpaM kAryyam । GawamAnaya iti SabdaprayojyaM avaDArayati tataSca GawamapasAraya gAmAnaya ityAdO AvApodbApAByAM GawAdipadAnAM kAryyAnvitaGawAdO SaktiM gfhRAti ॥ * ॥ evaM vAkyaSezAdapi SaktigrahaH । yaTA yavamayaScarurBavatItyatra yavapadasya dIrGaSUkaviSizwe AryyARAM prayogaH kaNgO ca mlecCAnAm । tatra hi yaTAnyA ozaDayo mlAyante taTEte modamAnA ivottizWanti ॥ “vasante sarvvaSasyAnAM jAyate patraSAtanam । modamAnASca tizWanti yavAH kaRiSaSAlinaH ॥” iti vAkyaSezAt dIrGaSUke SaktirnirRIyate kaNgO tu SaktiBramAt prayogaH । nAnASaktikalpane gOravAt । haripadAdO tu vinigamakABAvAnnAnASaktikalpanam ॥ * ॥ evaM vivaraRAdapi SaktigrahaH । vivaraRantu tatsamAnArTapadAntareRa tadarTakaTanam । yaTA Gawo'sti ityasya kalaso'stItyanena vivaraRAdvawapadasya kalase SaktigrahaH । evaM pacati ityasya pAkaM karoti ityanena vivaraRAdAKyAtasya yatnArTakatvaM kalpyate ॥ * ॥ evaM prasidDapadasAnniDyAdapi SaktigrahaH । yaTA । iha sahakAratarO maDuraM piko rOti ityAdO pikapadasya Saktigraha iti । tatra jAtAveva Saktirna tu vyaktO vyaBicArAdAnantyAcca ॥ * ॥ SaktaM padantu kvacidyOgikaM kvacidrUQaM kvacidyogarUQaM kvacidyOgikarUQam । yatrAvayavArTa eva buDyate tadyOgikaM yaTA pAcakAdipadam । yatrAvayavaSaktinErapekzeRa samudAyaSaktimAtreRa buDyate tadrUQaM yaTA gopadamaRqapAdi padam । yatra tu avayavaSaktivizaye samudAyaSaktirapyasti tadyogarUQaM yaTA paNkajAdipadam । taTA hi paNkajapadamavayavaSaktyA paNkajanikarttfrUpamarTaM boDayati samudAyaSaktyA ca padmatvena rUpeRa padmaM boDayati । yatra avayavArTarUQyarTayoH svAtantryeRa boDastadyOgikarUQaM yaTodBidAdipadam । tatra hi UrdDvaBedanakarttA tarugulmAdirapi buDyate । iti sidDAntamuktAvalI ॥
v: pu॰ Sabdena nirvfttaH aR karma॰ । anvayaboDe SabdajYAnajanye padArTasmftidbArake jYAnaBede nyAyamatam । SAbdatvaM tvanuBavatvavyApyaM jAtiBedaH tadboDaprakArAdi BAzA॰ uktaM yaTA “padajYAnantu karaRaM dvAraM tatra padArzaDIH । SAbdaboDaH PalaM tatra SaktiDoH sahakAriRI । lakzaRA SakyasambanDastAtparyyAnupapattitaH । AsattiyogyatAkANkzAtAtparyyajYAnamizyate” । BAzA॰ si॰ mu॰ vivftametat yaTA “SAbdaboDaprakAraM darSayati । padajYAnantvite । na tu jYAyamAnaM padaM karaRam padABAve'pi mOniSlokAdO SAbdavoDAt । padArTaDIriti । padajanyapadArTasmaraRaM vyApAraH । anyaTA padajYAnavataH pratyakzAdinA padArTopasTitAvapi SabdaboDApatteH । tatrApi vfttyA padajanyatvaM boDyam । anyaTA GawAdipadAt samavAyasambanDena yatrAkASasmaraRaM jAyate tatrAkASasyApi SAbdamoDApatteH । vfttiH SaktilakzaRAnyataraH sambanGaH । atrEva SaktijYAnasyozayogaH । pUrvaM SaktigrahABAve padajYAne'pi tatsambanDena smaraRAnupapatteH । padajYAnasya sambanDijYAnaviDayArTasmArakatvam । SaktiSca padena saha padArTasya sambanDaH । sA cAsmAcCabdAdayamarTo bodDavya itISvarecCArUpA । ADunike nAmni Saktirastyeva । “ekAdaSe'hani pitA nAma kuryyAt” itISvarecCAyAH sattvAt । ADunike tu saNkete na Saktiriti sampradAyaH । naGyAstu ISvarecCA na SaktiH kintvicCEva । tena ADunikasaNkete'pi SaktirastIti vadanti” ।
m: शाब्द—बोध m. ‘verbal knowledge’, apprehension of the meaning of words, perception of the verbal or literal sense (of a sentence &c.)
शाब्द—बोध—तरंगिणी f. a modern grammar by Īśvarīdatta.
शाब्द—प्रक्रिया f. a philosophical grammar by Rāma-kṛṣṇa.
शाब्द—त्व n. the being based on sounds or words &c., Sāh.
शाब्द—व्यञ्जना f. (in rhet.) suggestion or insinuation founded on mere words, (as opp. to आर्थ-व्˚, or suggestion dependent upon the meaning of words), MW.
शाब्दिकाभरण n. N. of a grammar by Dharma-kīrti.

a: शाब्दिक — a. (की f.) [शब्द-ठक्] 1 Verbal, oral. --2 Relating to sounds or words. --3 Sounding. --कः A grammarian.
